description: Consumer complaints about debt collection received by the US Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, with state, ZIP code and response dates.

licence.name: Freely available to use, analyze and build on (no licence named)

name: CFPB Consumer Complaint Database (Debt Collection)

recipe.reason: The bulk download is a zip of 355,930,383 bytes covering every product, and the debt collection subset is reachable only through the complaint search API, whose CSV export answers every request with a 400 naming its size parameter and whose JSON results past the first ten thousand are reached only through search_after break points, a paging no recipe reads; the subset is small enough to hold, so the obstacle is the paging and not the size.
